title: A NEW GENERATION, A FAITHFUL GOD

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: These were the ones counted by Moses and Eleazar the priest when they counted the Israelites on the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho. Not one of them was among those counted by Moses and Aaron the priest when they counted the Israelites in the Desert of Sinai. For the LORD had told those Israelites they would surely die in the wilderness, and not one of them was left except Caleb son of Jephunneh and Joshua son of Nun. - Num 26:63-65 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
The chapter closes with a sobering and yet hopeful note. Not one person counted in this census had been counted in the first one at Sinai, except Caleb and Joshua. The entire generation that had rebelled and refused to trust God had died in the wilderness, just as God had said. His word of judgment had come to pass exactly.

We must take this seriously. God had warned that the faithless generation would not enter the land, and it happened. His word is never empty. What He declares, He fulfils, whether in judgment or in blessing. The wilderness graves stood as testimony to the truth of God's word.

Yet notice the hope woven through this ending. A new generation now stood ready, poised on the edge of the Promised Land. God's purposes had not failed; they had simply moved forward to a new generation. And two faithful men, Caleb and Joshua, remained as living proof that those who trust God are preserved. Faith is never in vain.

Here is both warning and encouragement for us. God's word is sure, so we dare not treat it lightly. But God is also faithful to carry His purposes forward and to preserve those who trust Him. In Christ, we belong to a God who keeps every word and never abandons His people (Josh 21:45). Trust Him fully, and you will not be put to shame.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Do you take God's word, both His warnings and promises, seriously?
2. How do Caleb and Joshua encourage you to trust God?
3. What does it mean that God's purposes move forward even through generations?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Faithful God, Your word never fails, in warning or in promise. Help me trust You as Caleb and Joshua did, and to walk faithfully, knowing You preserve all who rely on You in Christ. Amen.
